This template literal looks like HTML and has interpolated variables. These variables are not HTML-encoded by default. If the variables contain HTML tags, these may be interpreted by the browser, resulting in cross-site scripting (XSS).
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): Markdown serializer for the comment mark (ui/src/editor/extensions.ts:77) — output is file text, not a DOM sink. The attribute value is the UI-minted UUID (BubbleToolbar.tsx:304) or content re-parsed from a doc the writer can already PUT wholesale (src/server/index.ts:324-363); rendering re-parses through the ProseMirror schema (extensions.ts:158-180), which keeps only schema-declared attributes and drops event handlers.
